reuse.why: Reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment helpers, but repeats the daily skip-versus-move policy outside getNextDate.

duplication.why: Upcoming dates, range dates, and budget scheduling each reproduce policy decisions also implemented in shared/schedules.ts.

placement.why: Holiday matching belongs in shared/schedules.ts, but server handlers and budget code also own schedule adjustment policy that belongs in that shared layer.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested scheduling changes, their consumers, tests, types, and release notes.

maintainability.why: Distributed policy branches, independently chosen iteration limits, and an untyped handler config make future scheduling changes require coordinated edits.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts implements occurrence adjustment outside getNextDate, while server/budget/schedule-template.ts selectively disables that helper's adjustment and applies its own policy.

disguised_duplication.where: The same daily skip-versus-move decision appears as skipsWeekendDays in getNextDate, an early branch in getUpcomingDates, moves/skips flags in getDatesInRange, and isDaily/movesWeekend in budget scheduling.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains the holidays parameter; getNextDate gains daily-specific selection, fallback, and movement branches; upcoming dates, range dates, and budget scheduling independently implement parts of the same policy.
